zh-Hans:
1.7.0 (176)
手记助手改用 iPad 完整右栏与 iPhone 独立面板。新增重新开始当前文档会话，保留原文档和旧消息。助手提交编辑后自动刷新，保留当前页、视图和未保存笔迹。当前文档的可撤销编辑无需单独设置权限，其他工具维持正常检查。包含 Ark DeepSeek 工具调用 ID 修复。

请重点测试：助手添加／修改文字或导图后即时显示；书写保存与助手修改同时进行；重开会话后旧运行停止、普通聊天不出现手记记录；iPad 分屏、iPhone 键盘及较大字体。Office 原生功能需真机检查。Qwen 真机恢复、完整原生包和媒体目录仍未完成；此候选不代表所有功能已验收。
en-US:
1.7.0 (176)
The document assistant uses a full-height iPad column or an iPhone sheet. Restart a document conversation while retaining its document and old messages. Committed assistant edits refresh automatically, preserving the page, viewport and unsaved ink. Undoable edits to the current document use its native grant; other tools retain normal permission checks. Includes the Ark DeepSeek tool-call identity fix.

Check live text and mind-map updates, concurrent ink saving, stopped previous runs after restart, separation from ordinary chat, split views, keyboard and large text. Native Office needs device checks. Qwen device recovery and complete native package/media catalogs remain incomplete.
